purpose: Define explicit creation, update, promotion and removal operations for canonical memory so model output, tool output or conversation content cannot silently become persistent memory.

topics.name: Memory Write Policy
topics.purpose: Define explicit creation, update, promotion and removal operations for canonical memory so model output, tool output or conversation content cannot silently become persistent memory.

semantics.model_rule: Model output is inert candidate data until an explicit memory-write operation accepts it.
semantics.promotion_rule: Transient context/cache may be promoted only through a declared operation with provenance.
semantics.update_rule: Update targets an exact Memory Record identity.
semantics.delete_rule: Removal/tombstone semantics are explicit and preserve audit/history where required.
semantics.validation_rule: Write validates scope, schema/value semantics and authority before commit.
semantics.dedupe_rule: Similarity/deduplication may propose reconciliation but cannot silently merge distinct memory identities.

invariants.rule: Machine-significant memory is explicit addressable provenance-bearing data; retrieval and storage never create hidden authority or implicit execution.

hard_gates.condition: write target chosen by fuzzy similarity only
